_comment: The dig-in mission — 2f and 2g, docs/decisions/0041. A dug-in defender around the objectives against an attacker at roughly three and a half to one, arriving in three waves of assault tanks from the western edge. The defender is outnumbered and outranged on nothing: it sees further, hits harder, and starts unspotted and hull down. The attacker has numbers, and numbers arrive on a clock.
name: Dig In
